# UPNG.js

Photopea's MIT-licensed PNG codec, pinned to
[88f504b6577b726975f593caa38ba85d327c7c1f](https://github.com/photopea/UPNG.js/tree/88f504b6577b726975f593caa38ba85d327c7c1f).
The browser module uses this repository's vendored fflate for zlib encoding
and exports the codec as an ES module for use in the atlas worker.
